because: What 'added' means for the three verifiable negatives of ADR-0056 D5. Read by tools/quality/check-pr-negatives.ts at the MERGE BASE of the pull request, never from its head: a pull request cannot set the rules it is judged by. Every pattern is a regular expression over the repository-relative path, compiled case-insensitively.

workflow.because: ADR-0056 D5 names the files of .github/workflows/. Any file added at or under it counts, compared case-insensitively, a file GitHub would not run included; so does any symlink or type change at or under it, and a symlink that replaces one of its parent directories: through a link, the files that run are whatever the target holds.

schema.because: Measured on 2026-10-23 over the served branch of the 22 unarchived libre-ai repositories, fixtures excluded: 320 tracked paths end in .schema.json, every file under a schemas/ directory among them. The patterns go wider than the measure, as the 2026-10-23 review asked: the .schema suffix in JSON or YAML, a file named schema.json or schema.yaml, any JSON or YAML file under a schema/ or schemas/ directory, and, by content, any added .json whose root $schema names a JSON Schema meta-schema. Rerun the measure: for each repository, `gh api repos/libre-ai/<repo>/git/trees/<served branch>?recursive=1 --jq '.tree[] | select(.type=="blob") | .path' | grep -i schema | grep -v fixture`.

dependency.because: Read manifests are matched by exact file name at any depth; a section path is dotted, and `*` matches any one key. A dependency is added when: a manifest, lockfile or manifest of an unread format is added (vendored, or without a single entry, included); an entry appears in a dependency or override section; an existing entry changes provenance (npm alias target, a git/github/http/file/link/portal/other protocol spec, a path or shorthand spec, or the Cargo keys of provenance.tableKeys appearing or changing); a submodule is added or .gitmodules changes; a workflow or action file gains a `uses:` (compared without its @ref). A version change alone is not one, and neither is a lockfile only modified. A manifest of an unread format that changes, a file of the scan that is a symlink at the base or the head, and anything unparsable make the negative unverifiable.
